lines.en: label karinspring5:
scene sky
I’m going to Uzbekistan today.
lines.zh: 我今天要去乌兹别克斯坦。

lines.en: Not literally, of course. Walls.
lines.zh: 当然不是字面意义上的。有墙嘛。

lines.en: I mean mentally. Just not {i}entirely{/i} mentally because I have no clue what type of place Uzbekistan actually is or why I’d ever go there in the first place. I’m sure it’s fine.
lines.zh: 我是说精神上。也不{i}完全{/i}是精神上，因为我压根不知道乌兹别克斯坦到底是个什么地方，也不知道我一开始为什么要去那儿。我相信那儿挺好的。

lines.en: But there’s this poem I read with Ami the other day — one that dragged on for far too long — about some guy who carved out an empire and fell for some girl or something. His name was Timur and he was lame.
lines.zh: 但前几天我和 Ami 读了一首诗——长得要命——讲某个家伙打下一片帝国，然后爱上了某个姑娘之类的。他叫 Timur，还是个瘸子。

lines.en: But he had passion — something I lack. And that made me jealous of him despite all of the anger that was gradually building up over the course of an unnecessarily long poem.
lines.zh: 但他有激情——那正是我缺的东西。尽管在这首冗长得毫无必要的诗里，我的火气一点点往上冒，我还是嫉妒他。

lines.en: So today, my goal is to be like him. My goal is to find passion for love or imperial expansion or whatever it is that gets me to feel like I’m living for {i}something{/i} rather than just living.
lines.zh: 所以今天，我的目标是像他一样。我的目标是找到对爱情的激情，或者对开疆拓土的激情，或者随便什么能让我觉得自己是在「为{i}某事{/i}而活」、而不是「只是活着」的东西。

lines.en: But it has to be Uzbekistan because there is no purity here and, from what I’ve heard, that’s where it’s lost. Which also means it’s where it can be found.
lines.zh: 但必须是乌兹别克斯坦，因为这里没有纯粹，而我听说，纯粹正是在那儿失落的。这也意味着它能在那儿被找回来。

lines.en: The adventures of Steve continue alone.
lines.zh: Steve 的冒险继续独自展开。

lines.en: : Mmm!
scene karincarry1
Oh. Never mind. Apparently Karli is here too.
lines.zh: 哦。当我没说。看来 Karli 也在。

lines.en: : Ugh! I never should have agreed to bring all of these ingredients to the soup kitchen alone!
lines.zh: : 唉！我真不该答应一个人把这些食材全搬到施粥处去！

lines.en: : Need some help, miss?
lines.zh: : 需要帮忙吗，小姐？

lines.en: scene karincarry2
: Oh my goodness, yes! That would be-
lines.zh: : 天哪，要！那真是——

lines.en: scene karincarry3
: Oh. It’s you.
lines.zh: : 哦。是你。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, I’m not stalking you. I’m just a concerned citizen looking out for anyone who might need help on the way to Uzbekistan.
lines.zh: : 别担心，我不是在跟踪你。我只是个热心市民，在去乌兹别克斯坦的路上留意有没有人需要帮忙。

lines.en: : Ooooh, one more lie from a pathological liar. What a surprise.
lines.zh: : 噢———，病态说谎者的又一句谎话。真让人意外。

lines.en: : You’re saucy today, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你今天嘴挺冲的啊？

lines.en: scene karincarry4
: No! I’m soupy today! And I will continue to {i}be{/i} soupy all by myself because the alternative is accepting help from a bad person!
lines.zh: : 不是！我今天是一身汤！而且我会一个人{i}继续{/i}一身汤下去，因为另一个选项是接受一个坏人的帮助！

lines.en: : So do you just spend {i}all{/i} of your free time going around the city doing nice things for people?
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}所有{/i}的空闲时间都在城里到处给人做好事？

lines.en: : Not all of it! I do nice things for animals {i}too{/i} sometimes!
lines.zh: : 不是所有！我有时候{i}也{/i}给动物做好事！

lines.en: : Karin, I know you hate me, but you can let me help you. We’re in broad daylight. Do you really think I’d do something to hurt you {i}here?{/i} After the millions of times we’ve met outside before?
lines.zh: : Karin，我知道你恨我，但你可以让我帮忙。现在是大白天。你真觉得我会在{i}这儿{/i}对你做什么吗？在我们之前那么多次在户外见面之后？

lines.en: scene karincarry5
: No. But I didn’t think you’d do something to hurt me when we were alone either and {i}that{/i} backfired quite dramatically.
lines.zh: : 不。但我之前也没想到，我们单独相处时你会伤害我，而{i}那次{/i}的后果可是相当惨烈。

lines.en: : Fine. I guess I’ll just leave you alone to drop all of those ingredients and let a bunch of poor and/or homeless people go hungry then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我就让你一个人把这些食材全摔了，让一群穷人和/或无家可归的人饿肚子好了。

lines.en: scene karincarry1
: Mm! Why did Touka have to be busy today?! I forgot how hard this was without her help!
lines.zh: : 嗯！为什么 Touka 今天偏偏有事啊？！我都忘了没有她帮忙这活儿有多难！

lines.en: : Walking away now. Bye, Karin.
lines.zh: : 我走了啊。拜拜，Karin。

lines.en: scene karincarry4
: Okay, fine! You can help! On {i}one{/i} condition!
lines.zh: : 好吧好吧！你可以帮忙！但有{i}一个{/i}条件！

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re in the position to be making demands right now?
lines.zh: : 你确定你现在有资格提条件吗？

lines.en: scene karincarry6
: Are you sure you’re not a big, dumb, stupid jerk-face?
lines.zh: : 你确定你不是个大蠢笨的混蛋脸吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不确定。

lines.en: : Then no. I’m {i}not{/i} in the position to be making demands right now. But I’m going to anyway because you owe me and because you’re an adult and you have to be nice and not scary or else.
lines.zh: : 那就是不确定。我现在确实{i}没{/i}资格提条件。但我还是要提，因为你欠我的，还因为你是大人，你必须和气、不许吓人，否则就……

lines.en: : Or else what?
lines.zh: : 否则怎样？

lines.en: : Or else something bad is gonna happen.
lines.zh: : 否则就会有坏事发生。

lines.en: : No. I {i}don’t{/i} have more details. I might not even {i}know{/i} what the bad thing is yet. But it’s gonna happen, Sensei. Unless you follow my demands.
lines.zh: : 没有。我{i}没有{/i}更多细节。我可能连那件坏事是什么都还不{i}知道{/i}。但它一定会发生，Sensei。除非你照我的要求做。

lines.en: : I planned on following them this whole time. I just don’t know what they are yet.
lines.zh: : 我从头到尾都打算照做。我只是还不知道它们是什么。

lines.en: scene black
: Take the plastic bags. The paper ones have cookies in them and I do {i}not{/i} trust you with them.
lines.zh: : 拿塑料袋。纸袋里装的是饼干，我可{i}不{/i}放心交给你。

lines.en: : Yes, madam. What other rules will you have me follow today?
lines.zh: : 遵命，女士。今天还有别的规矩要我遵守吗？

lines.en: scene karincarry7
: Stay at least five steps behind me at all times.
lines.zh: : 随时保持至少五步的距离，走在我后面。

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白。

lines.en: : And don’t look at me either.
lines.zh: : 还有，也不许看我。

lines.en: scene karincarry8
: Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白。

lines.en: : Liar. I bet you’re looking at me right now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 骗子。我打赌你现在就在看我，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m really not. I’m looking at a cat, actually.
lines.zh: : 真没有。其实我在看一只猫。

lines.en: scene karincarry9
: One more lie from a pathological liar. I bet-
lines.zh: : 病态说谎者的又一句谎话。我打赌——

lines.en: scene karincarry10
: Aww, kitty! Look at how precious she is!
lines.zh: : 啊，小猫咪！你看她多可爱啊！

lines.en: scene karincarry11
: Don’t you want to just take her home and give her a nice, warm bed to fall asleep in while you gently stroke her ears and comb her hair and buy her toys and do all sorts of nice things for her?
lines.zh: : 你难道不想把她带回家，给她一张温暖舒服的床让她睡，一边轻轻摸她的耳朵、给她梳毛、给她买玩具，对她做各种好事吗？

lines.en: : Oh, right! Probably not! Because you’re a big, dumb, stupid jerk-face!
lines.zh: : 哦，对！大概不想！因为你是个大蠢笨的混蛋脸！

lines.en: : If you’re trying to get me to disagree with that, I’m not going to. Calling me a big, dumb, stupid jerk-face is actually putting it kind of nicely. You called me way worse when we spoke near my house.
lines.zh: : 如果你指望我反驳，那我不会。叫我大蠢笨的混蛋脸其实已经算客气的了。上次在我家附近那次，你骂得难听多了。

lines.en: : And I meant every word!
lines.zh: : 而且我每一句都是认真的！

lines.en: scene karincarry12
: I guess you haven’t been horrible today, though...as much as I don’t want to admit that.
lines.zh: : 不过你今天还不算太讨厌……虽然我很不想承认。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t absolve you for what-
lines.zh: : 但这不能抵掉你做过的——

lines.en: : I don’t {i}want{/i} to be absolved. So please stop making it sound like I’m only doing this to try and be forgiven or...get back on your good side. I know that’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 我并不{i}想{/i}被抵掉。所以别再把它说成我这么做只是为了求得原谅，或者……想重回你心里。我知道那不可能了。

lines.en: scene karincarry13
: Even if I completely ruined our relationship, though...I can still support you. Just...silently, most of the time. When you don’t need help carrying things.
lines.zh: : 不过就算我彻底毁了我们的关系……我仍然可以支持你。只是……大多数时候是默默地。在你不需要人帮忙搬东西的时候。

lines.en: : Support me in what?
lines.zh: : 支持我什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Soccer? Softball? Swimming? Helping cats...and delivering scallions? All sorts of stuff.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。足球？垒球？游泳？帮猫……还有送大葱？各种各样的事。

lines.en: : I’ve always been a fan of yours. Finding someone truly {i}good{/i} in life is hard. But you have a passion for that and...you stick to it. It’s admirable. Kind of like Timur.
lines.zh: : 我一直都很欣赏你。这世上要找到一个{i}真正善良{/i}的人很难。但你对这件事有热情，而且……你坚持下来了。这很了不起。有点像 Timur。

lines.en: scene karincarry14
: Timur? Who’s that?
lines.zh: : Timur？那是谁？

lines.en: : Someone from a poem who’d probably become increasingly {i}less{/i} relatable the more you knew about him.
lines.zh: : 一首诗里的人，你知道得越多，大概就{i}越不{/i}会觉得他有什么共鸣。

lines.en: : Do you read stuff like that often? Poetry.
lines.zh: : 你经常读那种东西吗？诗歌。

lines.en: : I used to. And I guess I’ve been getting back into it lately. But...mostly just to kill time. There’s not much more to it. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 以前是。最近大概又重新捡起来了。不过……多半只是打发时间。没什么更深的原因。你问这个干嘛？

lines.en: scene karincarry15
: I just know Ami’s into that stuff and wasn’t sure if she got it from you or not.
lines.zh: : 我只是知道 Ami 喜欢这些东西，不确定是不是跟你学的。

lines.en: : I read some of her entries for the poetry contest Miss Watabe ran a while ago. She’s really good. I never would have guessed. But if you were teaching her, it makes sense that-
lines.zh: : 我读过她参加 Watabe 老师办的那个诗歌比赛的几篇作品。她写得真好。我完全没想到。不过如果是你教她的，那就说得通——

lines.en: : It wasn’t me.
lines.zh: : 不是我。

lines.en: scene karincarry16
: She...got that from someone else.
lines.zh: : 她……是从别人那儿学来的。

lines.en: : Of course she’d be good at it, though. Feeling too much and needing to rely on...abstract tactics to put it into words sort of runs in the family at this point.
lines.zh: : 不过她擅长这个也是理所当然的。感受太多，只能靠……抽象的手法把它写成文字，到这地步，这大概算是他们家的家风了。

lines.en: : I heard she’s been calling you her dad lately.
lines.zh: : 我听说她最近管你叫爸爸了。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: How’d that happen?
lines.zh: : 怎么会变成这样？

lines.en: : You actually want to know?
lines.zh: : 你真的想知道？

lines.en: : I could just ask her, I guess. But I try not to talk about you with other people anymore since I apparently always start acting really weird.
lines.zh: : 我也可以直接问她，我想。但我尽量不再跟别人谈起你了，因为我一谈就明显会变得很奇怪。

lines.en: scene karincarry17
: Which I...used to {i}also{/i} do as well, apparently. But it’s in a...much different way now.
lines.zh: : 而以前……我显然{i}也{/i}会这样。只是现在的方式……大不一样了。

lines.en: : I’ve been with her longer at this point than her {i}actual{/i} parents were before they died.
lines.zh: : 到如今，我跟她在一起的时间，已经超过了她{i}亲生{/i}父母去世前和她在一起的时间。

lines.en: scene karincarry18
: Most of that time’s a blur to me. I’m sure it is to her too. Either that or we just block it out, but...
lines.zh: : 那段日子对我来说大半都是一团模糊。对她大概也一样。又或者我们只是把它封存起来了，不过……

lines.en: : Sometimes, I feel like {i}I{/i} died with them. And that everything that’s happened afterward has been some sort of crazy dream I can’t wake up from. It’s hard to explain.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我觉得{i}我{/i}跟他们一起死了。之后发生的一切，都是某种我醒不过来的疯狂梦境。很难解释。

lines.en: : That’s probably why I hurt you. A bunch of other people too. Losing something so important so...early on in life...
lines.zh: : 那大概就是我伤害你的原因。还有伤害其他很多人的原因。在人生那么……早的时候，失去那么重要的东西……

lines.en: scene karincarry19
: I’m not going to wax poetic. I’ll just say that if {i}I{/i} took it that poorly, Ami probably took it {i}worse.{/i} And I owe it to her now to try and be what she {i}needs{/i} me to be — a father.
lines.zh: : 我不打算大发诗兴。我只想说，如果{i}我{/i}都承受得那么糟，Ami 大概{i}更糟{/i}。而我现在欠她的，就是努力成为她{i}需要{/i}的那个人——一个父亲。

lines.en: scene karincarry20
: Sorry. I know you couldn’t give less of a shit about me. I should’ve just let you ask Ami.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我知道你一点都不在乎我。我该让你去问 Ami 的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry too. That...you had to go through all of that.
lines.zh: : 我也很抱歉。你……不得不经历这一切。

lines.en: : It’s fine. You weren’t driving the other car.
lines.zh: : 没事。开另一辆车的又不是你。

lines.en: : But if you were, it would definitely help explain the accident since you’d have been way under the legal age to drive back then.
lines.zh: : 不过要是你开的，那肯定能很好地解释那场事故——毕竟那时候你远远没到能开车的法定年龄。

lines.en: : I can still be sorry if it wasn’t my fault. They were your family and you lost them. I don’t even want to think about how I’d feel if my parents were just...gone one day.
lines.zh: : 就算不是我的错，我还是可以感到抱歉。他们是你的家人，而你失去了他们。我甚至不敢去想，如果有一天我爸妈就这么……没了，我会有多难受。

lines.en: : Well, you’re more mature now than I’ve ever been, so I think you’d handle it better than me. But still...it’s not something I’d wish upon anyone.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你现在比我这辈子任何时候都成熟，所以我觉得你会比我处理得好。不过话虽如此……这种事我也不希望落在任何人头上。

lines.en: : Also, since I know you’re plagued with compassion and seeing the “good” in everyone, please don’t let my past influence your thought process in terms of rationalizing my attack on you.
lines.zh: : 还有，我知道你满心都是同情，总看得到每个人身上的「好」，所以请别让我的过去影响你的判断，别拿它来合理化我对你做的那件事。

lines.en: : It won’t...Compassion’s not a {i}plague{/i} though, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不会的……不过同情心不是{i}瘟疫{/i}，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m {i}glad{/i} I can still feel sorry for someone who has hurt me because it helps me understand them better. Forgiveness is another thing entirely. Forgiveness needs to be earned.
lines.zh: : 我很{i}庆幸{/i}自己还能为一个伤害过我的人感到难过，因为那能帮我更好地理解他。原谅完全是另一回事。原谅是需要去赢取的。

lines.en: : So what would it take exactly to go about earning yours, then?
lines.zh: : 那具体要怎么做，才能赢取你的原谅？

lines.en: scene black
: The only thing I can think of would put an end to all of this.
lines.zh: : 我唯一能想到的办法，会给这一切画上句号。

lines.en: scene karincarry21
An end sounds nice — a place to rest — my eyes are red as robins’ breasts/
lines.zh: 一个终结听起来不错——一处安息之地——我的双眼红如知更鸟的胸脯/

lines.en: My voice is weary — jagged rasps — no voice of God, just fangs of asps//
lines.zh: 我的嗓音疲惫——沙哑刺耳——没有上帝的声音，只有蝰蛇的毒牙//

lines.en: Egyptian cobras — stanza one — he touches me, I come undone///
lines.zh: 埃及眼镜蛇——诗节之一——他触碰我，我便溃散///

lines.en: Just peace and quiet — tangled veins — a nest for me to go insane////
lines.zh: 只要平静与安宁——纠缠的血管——一个供我发疯的巢////

lines.en: Every day, I slip closer to Him. This infection, this plague, this PARASITE, this {b}MADNESS{/b} that {b}ENDLESSLY{/b} hungers [[for the skin on the tips of my fingers] has {b}STOLEN{/b} the one thing that makes me {b}ME{/b}/////
lines.zh: 每一天，我都向祂滑近一分。这感染，这瘟疫，这寄-生-虫，这{b}无-止-境{/b}地渴求[[我指尖的皮肤]]的{b}疯-狂{/b}，{b}偷走{/b}了那个让我成为{b}我{/b}的唯一的东西/////

lines.en: Now, my mind rots as this body sinks deeper into a bed of nails purchased from the bishop’s kin — this bed of endless, wanton sin!
lines.zh: 如今，我的心智腐朽，这具身体越陷越深，沉进一张从主教亲族手里买来的钉床——这张无尽而放纵的罪之床！

lines.en: How can {b}I{/b} be crazy?! I have a {b}GIFT.{/b} Yet this worm torn from bodies past and placed into mine brings me {b}NO{/b} closer to {b}ENLIGHTENMENT.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我{/b}怎么会是疯子？！我拥有{b}天-赋{/b}。可这条从往昔的躯体里扯出、塞进我体内的蠕虫，却{b}丝毫{/b}没让我更接近{b}觉-悟{/b}。

lines.en: DO NOT LET IT PASS. DO NOT LET IT REACH HIM.
lines.zh: 别让它过去。别让它触及他。

lines.en: He is the purest example of the depths my love can reach, and to see his insides eaten by a part of {b}ME{/b} would-
lines.zh: 他是{b}我{/b}之爱所能抵达的深度最纯粹的例证，而看着他的内脏被属于我的一部分啃食，那会——

lines.en: Why-
lines.zh: 为什么——

lines.en: {b}I can hear salvation come.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我听见救赎来了。{/b}

lines.en: scene imissyoumore
scene squishsquosh
scene imissyoumore
scene squishsquosh
scene imissyoumore
scene squishsquosh
scene karincarry21
{b}EXT — Kanda family apartment, one hour and thirteen minutes after the departure of soup.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}外景——Kanda 家公寓，施粥送出一小时十三分钟之后。{/b}

lines.en: : Thanks for helping me today, Sensei. And for...going along with all of my demands.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今天帮我，Sensei。还有……陪我演完我提的那些要求。

lines.en: : No need to thank me. I didn’t have much going on anyway.
lines.zh: : 不用谢。反正我也没什么事。

lines.en: : What are you going to do now?
lines.zh: : 你接下来要做什么？

lines.en: : Probably go home and read some more. I need to find out about Timur’s happy ending.
lines.zh: : 大概回家再读点书。我得知道 Timur 的圆满结局。

lines.en: : Have you come up with anything else?
lines.zh: : 你想出别的了吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么别的？

lines.en: : To earn my forgiveness.
lines.zh: : 用来赢取我原谅的办法。

lines.en: : You didn’t seem to like what I proposed earlier, so maybe now is a good time to try and come up with something. If you really {i}do{/i} want to patch things up, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我刚才提的那个你好像不太乐意，所以现在也许正是想点别的办法的好时机。我是说，如果你{i}真{/i}想修补关系的话。

lines.en: : We can’t patch things up. That doesn’t work for me. I take these things and hold them inside forever. Ask the others I’ve hurt. You’ll forgive me long before I forgive myself.
lines.zh: : 我们修补不了。这一套对我没用。我把这些东西拿起来，然后永远揣在心里。去问问被我伤害过的其他人吧。你原谅我的时间，会远远早于我原谅自己。

lines.en: : All you need to do is come upstairs.
lines.zh: : 你要做的只是上楼来。

lines.en: : I can’t.
lines.zh: : 我做不到。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: scene karincarry22
: Because you’re a coward.
lines.zh: : 因为你是个懦夫。

lines.en: : I’m not asking you to tell them what you did to me — just to come face to face with them like a man. Introduce yourself. See that not {i}everything{/i} revolves around you.
lines.zh: : 我不是要你告诉他们你对我做了什么——只是像个男人一样跟他们面对面。介绍一下自己。看看并不是{i}所有事{/i}都围着你转。

lines.en: : But if you were to do that, it’d become too real...wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可如果你真那么做了，一切就会变得太真实了……对吧？

lines.en: : You can’t face them because you want to keep up the illusion that this is all some sort of fantasy. You want me to forgive you on my own because you think that’s just what I {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你不敢面对他们，是因为你想维持住「这一切不过是某种幻想」的幻觉。你想让我自己去原谅你，因为你以为那就是我会{i}做{/i}的事。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, though...because that’s just not true.
lines.zh: : 不过很抱歉……因为事实并非如此。

lines.en: : If you {i}really{/i} want to earn my forgiveness, I need you to show me that you {i}want{/i} it. And if you’re not going to risk {i}your{/i} safety for me...why should I risk {i}mine{/i} for you?
lines.zh: : 如果你{i}真{/i}想赢取我的原谅，我需要你向我证明你{i}想要{/i}它。而如果你连{i}自己{/i}的安危都不肯为我冒……我又凭什么要为你冒{i}我的{/i}？

lines.en: : I can’t meet your parents, Karin. I just...
lines.zh: : 我不能去见你父母，Karin。我只是……

lines.en: : I can’t.
lines.zh: : 我做不到。

lines.en: scene karincarry23
: Coward.
lines.zh: : 懦夫。

lines.en: : I’m not disagreeing with that at all. It doesn’t change the way I feel, though.
lines.zh: : 我完全没有要反驳的意思。不过这并不改变我的感受。

lines.en: : On the bright side, at least I get to see your conscience in action this time. Watching you feel guilty and bad is rewarding in its own way.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，至少这一次我能看到你的良知在运转。看着你内疚、难受，本身也有一种回报感。

lines.en: : But if you want me back...
lines.zh: : 不过如果你想让我回来……

scene karincarry25
scene black
$ karin_love += 1
$ karinspring5 = True
